description: Discover the best hotels in Kuta, Indonesia. Find exclusive deals and luxury accommodations.

hotels.title: Family-Friendly Hard Rock Bali Five-Star Escape
hotels.description: Dive headfirst into the ultimate family escape at the recently renovated Hard Rock Hotel Bali, a fun-filled, eco-friendly rock 'n' roll resort, just steps from famous Kuta Beach, ranked within the top 10% of properties on Tripadvisor and certified by the Global Sustainable Tourism Council (GSTC). Whether you’re looking to chill out or rock out, big and little kids alike have everything they need for an incredible stay, jam-packed with entertainment. Adults can relax in a poolside cabana or unwind in the Rock Spa, while the kids play games and make new friends at Roxity Kids' Club (for ages 4-12) or splash around in the waterpark. Fitness enthusiasts can work out at Body Rock Gym or try out the five-metre rock climbing wall, while teens can hang out in the ultra-cool TABU venue, complete with a multipurpose DJ booth, pool table, and PlayStation 4. Venture into Kuta for buzzing bars and restaurants, surf or sunbathe at Kuta Beach, or treat the family to a fun day out at Waterbom Bali, an action-packed water park with rides and dining options.

hotels.title: Kuta Beachfront Escape with Massages, Daily Breakfast & Nightly Free-Flow Cocktails
hotels.description: Set right on Kuta's beloved beachfront, this contemporary haven is that rare find where surf culture meets city convenience. Whether your ideal escape is relaxing by the rooftop infinity pool or hitting the surf with a board in hand after a lesson at the resort's surf school, here you'll find exactly what you're looking for. Never go hungry at the vibrant Street 32, serving up Western classics and traditional Indonesian bites 24-hours each day. Take in sunset views over one of Bali's most famous stretches of sand at the rooftop Kuta Social Club as you sip on a signature cocktail or refreshing juice. When you feel like venturing further afield, the iconic nightlife scene of Seminyak is just a short drive away.

hotels.title: Stylish Kuta Beachfront Escape with Sparkling Infinity Pool, Rooftop Restaurant & Bar
hotels.description: Soak up the sun-drenched allure of Bali's popular Kuta Beach from this design-forward luxury stay, overlooking the shimmering waters of the Indian Ocean. Blending effortless Balinese charm with a social club-inspired atmosphere, the hotel's chic interiors, plush rooms and lavish amenities ensure an unforgettable escape, mere steps from Kuta's golden sands. Spend your days indulging in Kuta's iconic sun, surf and sand, explore colourful markets and sample street food at nearby warungs. Return to your hotel's rooftop to enjoy a refreshing dip in the infinity pool and catch epic beach sunsets, all while savouring laidback bites and sipping on well-crafted cocktails at Afterglow Bar & Kitchen.

hotels.title: Comfortable Kuta Stay with Onsite Bar & Restaurant
hotels.description: Step into the heart of Kuta with a stay at this comfortable retreat, with the lively energy of Kuta Beach and Waterbon Bali's thrilling slides nearby. Whether it's for business or leisure, ibis Bali Kuta provides the perfect accommodation for a relaxing stay. After exploring the bustling local markets or catching a sunset at the beach, recharge with international and Indonesian favourites at Rendez-Vous or enjoy a casual drink at the onsite bar.
